## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(pdftools)
library(knitr)
library(corrplot)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(countrycode)
```


```{r cars}
#Cargar datos sobre las bandas de metal

# La ruta
ruta_metal<- "INPUT/Metal/metal_bands.csv"

#Si no existe, avisar
if (!file.exists(ruta_metal)){
  stop("No se ha encontrado el documento. Comprueba la ruta.")
}

# Leerla y cambiar los espacion o comillas po Na pa que sea mas facil de manipular
metal_bandas <- read.csv(
  ruta_metal, na = c("","NA")
)

# Echarle un vistazo rápido
summary(metal_bandas)
colnames(metal_bandas)

# Buscar lo de las abreviaciones, se supone que es mas facil de esta manera luego ligar las demas (o algo asi)
paises <- metal_bandas %>%
  filter(!is.na(Country), !Country %in% c("International", "Unknown")) %>%
  mutate(
    iso_pais = countrycode(
      Country, origin = "country.name", destination = "iso3c"
    )
  ) %>%
  
# Jutar los paises que SI existen y no sean NA
filter(!is.na(iso_pais)) %>%
group_by(iso_pais) %>%
summarise(n_bandas = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Vistazo rápido
view(paises)
```
```{r}
#Columna que sirven
col_usar <- c("Band.ID", "Name", "Country", "Genre", "Status")

if (!all(col_usar %in% names(metal_bandas))){
  stop( "No están todas las columnas"
  )
}

#Tabla nueva (mantener la original porsi)
metal <- metal_bandas%>%
  transmute(
    id_banda = as.character(Band.ID),
    nombre = trimws(as.character(Name)),
    pais = trimws(as.character(Country)),
    genero = trimws(as.character(Genre)),
    estado = trimws(as.character(Status)) 
      ) %>%
    mutate(
      pais = na_if(pais,""), genero = na_if(genero,""), estado = na_if(estado,"")
    )
#Datos limpios
view(metal)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
